ruleset.name: Zynqa
ruleset.description: Deprecated alias for the Magento standard. The standard was split per stack (Magento, Laravel) so Laravel repos are not measured against Magento rules. This alias keeps --standard=Zynqa working for anything still pointing at the old name; prefer --standard=Magento. The sniffs themselves still live under this directory and keep their Zynqa.* references.
